name: zsnd_wave_data_destructor
description: zSndWaveData::Destructor resets parsed state and frees the duplicated name/path string.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 /MD byte verification for 0x4a5440 zSndWaveData::Destructor through the zsnd_wave_data_destructor target passed with zero unmasked byte mismatches after masking 8 COFF relocation bytes.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x4a5440 validates calling zSndWaveData::Reset, then freeing non-null nameOrPath and returning void.
The native load/parse/reset smoke invokes Destructor after a constructor-loaded wave has reset parsed state.
The native archive smoke invokes Destructor after an archive-loaded wave with allocated fileData and duplicated nameOrPath.
The native edge smoke invokes Destructor after zSndWaveData(loadNow=0) and after a missing archive load, covering duplicated-path cleanup with and without parsed wave data.
